exposure: maternal heart rate in the postoperative period
cohort: The study included 46 women and their fetuses who underwent open or fetoscopic myelomeningocele repair at Texas Children's Fetal Center between 2011 and 2015.
finding: Postoperative maternal heart rate was associated with a higher likelihood of preterm labor, while nulliparity and lower intraoperative diastolic pressure were associated with increased odds of preterm delivery after in utero surgery.
